meta.scope: UAE Batch 10 — OPEC residual densification: OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report, OPEC+ production framing, and UAE exit from OPEC. International oil-market influence remains material even after UAE departure.

reports.title: OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report (MOMR)
reports.publisher: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
reports.description: Flagship recurring publication of OPEC. Provides assessments of crude oil prices (including the OPEC Reference Basket), world oil demand and supply, non-DoC liquids production, and related market analysis. Continues to be published after the UAE’s May 2026 departure.

reports.title: OPEC+ / Declaration of Cooperation production-policy framing
reports.publisher: Derived from OPEC and monitoring sources
reports.description: System-level framing of the OPEC+ (Declaration of Cooperation) production-policy architecture. Core members continue to set output adjustments that influence global crude supply and price formation. UAE departure in May 2026 reduced the group’s share of world production and capacity but did not eliminate the mechanism.

reports.title: UAE exit from OPEC (May 2026)
reports.publisher: Derived from official and monitoring sources
reports.description: One-off foundational event: the United Arab Emirates announced its departure from OPEC effective 1 May 2026. The exit reduced OPEC’s and OPEC+’s share of global crude production and capacity; the UAE retains independent production and export policy while remaining a major global supplier.

_dropped.why: While the MOMR historically covered UAE production as an OPEC member, after the May 2026 exit the UAE is treated as a non-member. No post-exit MOMR text was located in this pass that asserts a continuing formal data dependency on a UAE official production series.
The exit clearly affects the composition of OPEC+, but no single document with a quotable methodological or data-dependency claim linking the two defined nodes was retrieved.

_dropped.edge: OPEC Reference Basket price series as standalone node
_dropped.why: The ORB is reported inside the MOMR. A separate high-frequency price node could be justified later if a clean standalone series is preferred; for now it is treated as content of the MOMR.
